🎮 HOW TO PLAY FISHSLOP 3D

🕹️ Submarine Controls (Subnautica Style)

  • W / S: Thrust Forward / Reverse
  • A / D: Steer Left / Right (Yaw)
  • SPACE: Ascend towards water surface
  • C / CTRL: Dive down towards tank floor
  • SHIFT: Afterburner Turbo Boost
  • MOUSE LOOK: Click canvas to lock mouse for smooth 3D steering
  • L: Toggle High-Beam Headlights
  • V / C: Toggle 3rd-Person Chase / 1st-Person Cockpit View

🐠 Fish Feeding & Insaniquarium Economy

  • F or LEFT CLICK: Drop food pellet from sub belly hatch.
  • Hunger States: Fish turn green & cry when hungry. If starved, they die!
  • Growth: Fish grow from Baby → Medium → King Guppy as they eat.
  • Coins: Fish drop Bronze, Silver, Gold coins & Diamonds! Fly your sub over coins or use the tractor magnet to collect them.
  • RIGHT CLICK / E: Fire defense torpedoes at invading tank monsters!
  • VICTORY GOAL: Buy all 3 Egg Pieces from the top bar to hatch the mythical Golden Aqua-Dragon!
